captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a unique, stylized gaming die featuring a spherical body intersected with flat circular faces on all six sides. Each of the six protruding circular faces contains recessed hemispherical dimples representing the standard pip values from one to six. The corners of the bounding cube are heavily rounded off, creating a smooth, sculptural aesthetic that stands out from standard sharp-edged dice.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric gaming die in OpenSCAD with highly rounded corners and protruding circular faces. The user should be able to customize the die width, choose between standard dot pips or custom character engravings for each face, toggle rounded corners, and adjust the resolution of the curved geometry.
captions.factory: The script defines a main module that uses a difference operation to subtract the pip symbols from the main die body. The die body is constructed in the 'die_cube' module using an intersection of a 'cube' and a 'sphere' to achieve rounded corners, combined with an optional hollow/floating face structure made from intersecting cylinders. The pips are generated by subtracting spheres positioned at specific coordinates on each of the six faces, or optionally using the 'writecube' module from the 'write.scad' library for text characters.
